text:
Maya Li: Hi @Tina (People Ops)  I recently returned from leave and need a lactation accommodation: 2x30min pump breaks daily for the next 6 weeks, a private lockable space near my desk, and access to a small fridge for milk storage. Prefer this stays confidential.

Tina (People Ops): Hi Maya  congrats on your little one and thanks for letting us know. We can file an accommodation intake or handle it informally; filing creates a confidential case. Which would you prefer? We can also coordinate fridge access with Office Ops and mark the calendar events as private. :baby_bottle: 

Maya Li: I'd like it on record, please file the intake. Also can Office Ops confirm which room we can use and whether the fridge is available? Don't want team notifications.

Office Ops: @Maya Li we have two lactation rooms (Room G2, Room L1). Room G2 has a small dedicated fridge and lockable cabinet. I can reserve a recurring slot for you Mon-Fri 10:00 & 15:00, or you can book ad hoc via the room calendar. We will set invites to private.

Maya Li: Recurring slots would be easiest. Please reserve G2 at those times. Thank you.

Tina (People Ops): Filing intake: https://intra.redwood/hr/ada-request. Case ID HR-2026-412. Note added: 2 daily 30-min pump breaks, Room G2 reserved, fridge access requested. Visibility limited to People Ops and Facilities.

Facilities Bot: [Automated] Room G2 reserved for Maya Li recurring Mon-Fri 10:00 and 15:00 through 2026-07-31. Calendar events set to "Private  Appointment". Fridge access request logged; keycard access will be updated.

Maya Li: Appreciate it. One worrywill this be visible in my performance packet or to my manager in a way that affects calibration? I don't want any bias.

Tina (People Ops): It will not include medical details. We can add a neutral administrative note in your manager's view: "Approved lactation accommodation: private room and schedule breaks." It won't affect calibration and won't state medical info. If you'd like, we can also ask your manager to note coverage arrangements during weekly standups so nothing is misinterpreted.

Maya Li: That would help. Could you also confirm refrigeration policy (how long milk can stay) and whether anyone else can access the cabinet?

Office Ops: Fridge policy: labeled containers only, 72-hour recommended storage; cabinet access limited to cardholders assigned by Facilities. We'll assign the cabinet to you only.

hrbot: [Automated] Accommodation case HR-2026-412 updated. People Ops will follow up within 3 business days to confirm logistics.

Maya Li: Thank you all  this makes returning much easier. :heart:
